condition.expression: switching_measured AND NOT switching_present AND vin_present AND vcc_present AND en_present AND no_confirmed_short
condition.notes: Switching was measured and is absent with VIN+VCC+EN all present. The controller is not driving the switch. Either the controller IC is faulty (no gate drive) or the switch FET is open / its gate resistor is open.

next_steps.action: No switching with VIN+VCC+EN present. Probe the gate-drive pin(s) with a scope. If gate-drive is dead, the controller IC is faulty. If gate-drive is present but the switch node doesn't toggle, the switch FET is open or its gate resistor is open.

measure.where: Controller gate-drive pin + switch node (inductor input)
measure.expected: Gate-drive toggling at the switching frequency; switch node toggling between VIN and ground.
measure.safety: Powered. Use a 10x probe; ground near the switch node.

interpretations.then: Controller IC is not driving the gate. Replace the controller (verify with the replacement engine).
Switch FET is open or gate resistor is open. Check the FET (unpowered resistance) and the gate resistor.
